from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AccountsReceivableRecord(BaseModel):
    """Accounts receivable data extracted from one quarterly financial report."""
    company: str = Field(description="Company name; '汤臣倍健' for this task")
    period: str = Field(description="Reported period, e.g., '2021 Q1', '2022 Q1'")
    period_end_ar: float | None = Field(description="Accounts receivable balance at the end of the reported period")
    previous_end_ar: float | None = Field(description="Accounts receivable balance at the end of previous period (prior year end)")
    change_percent: float | None = Field(description="Percentage change from previous period, as stated in document")
    change_reason: str | None = Field(description="Reason stated for the change in accounts receivable")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    accounts_receivable_records: list[AccountsReceivableRecord]
